name: zinput_restart_primary_fire_effect
description: zInputDI::RestartPrimaryFireEffect is a no-op without a primary force-feedback effect and otherwise stops and restarts the primary fire effect once.
known_limits: Binary Ninja assembly/HLIL inspection in the current session verified the fastcall effect-set receiver, null PrimaryFire early return, DirectInput effect Stop vtable call at slot +0x20, and Start vtable call at slot +0x1c with one iteration and zero flags.
The native smoke verifies the null-primary no-op path and the stop-then-start side effects for the primary force-feedback effect.
No VC object-byte manifest covers 0x42faa0 yet; tier S verification is deferred to the zInput/provider ABI pass.
